मंजिलें उन्हीं को मिलती हैं, जिनके सपनों में जान होती है,
पंखों से कुछ नहीं होता, हौसलों से उड़ान होती है।

(Multiple Choice Q & A)
--------------------------------------
1 .Which Union Ministry organized the World Patient Safety Day 2026 in India?
भारत में विश्व रोगी सुरक्षा दिवस 2026 का आयोजन किस केंद्रीय मंत्रालय द्वारा किया गया?
Answer: -   Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण मंत्रालय

2 .What was the theme of World Patient Safety Day 2026?
विश्व रोगी सुरक्षा दिवस 2026 की थीम क्या थी?
Answer: -   Safe Care for Noncommunicable Diseases (NCDs) / गैर-संचारी रोगों के लिए सुरक्षित देखभाल

3 .Who became the first woman army officer to serve as the Aide-De-Camp (ADC) to the President of India?
भारत के राष्ट्रपति की एड-डी-कैंप (ADC) के रूप में सेवा देने वाली पहली महिला सेना अधिकारी कौन बनीं?
Answer: -   Major Navya Shekhawat / मेजर नव्या शेखावत

4 .Where was the 5th edition of 'Semicon India 2026' inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi?
'सेमीकॉन इंडिया 2026' के 5वें संस्करण का उद्घाटन प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी द्वारा कहाँ किया गया?
Answer: -   Yashobhoomi, New Delhi / यशोभूमि, नई दिल्ली

5 .Which law containing provisions to impose up to 100% tariffs on major buyers of Russian crude oil and natural gas was passed by the US Congress?
अमेरिकी संसद ने रूसी कच्चे तेल और प्राकृतिक गैस के प्रमुख खरीदार देशों पर 100% तक टैरिफ लगाने के प्रावधान वाला कौन-सा कानून पारित किया?
Answer: -   Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026 / लिंडसे ओ. ग्राहम सेंक्शनिंग रूस एंड ईरान एक्ट 2026

6 .In which Indian state was the 3rd BIMSTEC Conference on Traditional Medical Knowledge held?
पारंपरिक चिकित्सा ज्ञान पर तीसरा बिम्सटेक (BIMSTEC) सम्मेलन किस भारतीय राज्य में आयोजित किया गया?
Answer: -   Goa / गोवा

7 .Who became the Indian batsman to score the fastest T20I century in 30 balls against Afghanistan in September 2026?
सितंबर 2026 में अफगानिस्तान के खिलाफ 30 गेंदों में सबसे तेज टी20I शतक लगाने वाले भारतीय बल्लेबाज कौन बने?
Answer: -   Abhishek Sharma / अभिषेक शर्मा

8 .Who has been recently appointed as the Vice-President of the International Cricket Council (ICC)?
हाल ही में अंतर्राष्ट्रीय क्रिकेट परिषद (ICC) के उपाध्यक्ष के रूप में किसे नियुक्त किया गया है?
Answer: -   Tavengwa Mukuhalani / तवेंगवा मुकुहलानी

9 .In which city is the international conference on the theme 'Future of Environment and Climate Mobility' being organized by the National Green Tribunal (NGT)?
राष्ट्रीय हरित अधिकरण (NGT) द्वारा 'पर्यावरण और जलवायु गतिशीलता का भविष्य' विषय पर अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सम्मेलन किस शहर में आयोजित किया जा रहा है?
Answer: -   Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi / विज्ञान भवन, नई दिल्ली

10 .Which state announced to celebrate 17th September every year as 'Annapurna Diwas'?
किस राज्य ने प्रतिवर्ष 17 सितंबर को 'अन्नपूर्णा दिवस' के रूप में मनाने की घोषणा की?
Answer: -   West Bengal / पश्चिम बंगाल

11 .In which state/union territory was the 'Namo Shramik Seva Kendra' and Gig Workers Resting Place inaugurated?
किस राज्य/केंद्र शासित प्रदेश में 'नमो श्रमिक सेवा केंद्र' और गिग वर्कर्स विश्राम स्थल का उद्घाटन किया गया?
Answer: -   Delhi / दिल्ली

12 .According to the new rules, what will be the maximum validity of a normal passport issued to children below 15 years of age?
नए नियमों के अनुसार, 15 वर्ष से कम आयु के बच्चों को जारी किए जाने वाले सामान्य पासपोर्ट की अधिकतम वैधता कितनी होगी?
Answer: -   5 years (or until turning 18) / 5 वर्ष (या 18 वर्ष की आयु पूरी होने तक)

On 18 September 2026, a distinguished literary ceremony was held in New Delhi to mark the 95th birth anniversary of Shrikant Verma. On the occasion, eminent Hindi poet, critic, translator, editor and cultural personality Ashok Vajpeyi was conferred the prestigious “Shrikant Verma Shikhar Samman”. This was the 18th edition of the Shrikant Verma Literature Award.

The award comprised a cash prize of ₹21 lakh, a citation and a seven-kilogram solid Panchdhatu statue of Shrikant Verma. The honour was presented to Ashok Vajpeyi in recognition of his distinguished and long-standing contribution to Hindi literature, Indian art and culture.

Eminent poet Arun Kamal attended the ceremony as the Chief Guest, while renowned painter Paramjit Singh presided over the event. Mamta Kalia, Prof. Purushottam Agrawal and Vinod Bhardwaj shared their memories of Shrikant Verma and reflected upon his literary contribution.

The programme opened with a musical presentation by acclaimed classical vocalist Vidushi Sudha Raghuraman, who presented a musical interpretation of Shrikant Verma’s celebrated work “Magadh”. A short film on his life, literary contribution and legacy was also screened.

In his Vote of Thanks, Dr Abhishek Verma, Managing Trustee of the Shrikant Verma Trust and the only son of Shrikant Verma, said that literature and politics should always remain separate. He stressed that very few people today are genuinely committed to the welfare of writers, and that there is an urgent need to protect, nurture and encourage both literature and literary personalities.

Dr Verma also observed that sincere efforts made for the advancement of literature are sometimes viewed through the prism of politics, criticism and personal hostility, which ultimately harms literature itself. He reiterated that the Shrikant Verma Trust would continue to uphold and advance the values associated with the protection of literature and the rights of writers with dedication and conviction.
